summary: OpenAI's student offer grants eligible U.S. college students four free months of ChatGPT Plus (an $80 value, including ChatGPT Work and premium features). Student status is verified through SheerID, and the offer must be claimed by October 31.
claim_steps: Visit the student offer page: https://chatgpt.com/students/2026
Verify your student status through SheerID (school SSO or supporting documentation).
Once approved, activate your 4-month free ChatGPT Plus.

social_proof.author: Veee
social_proof.text: ChatGPT Student Offer is back! Eligible students can get 4 months of ChatGPT Plus for free (up to $80 value). How to claim: visit the student offer page, verify your student status through SheerID, then activate your 4-month free Plus.
